e5-platform-ss-credential-monitor.purpose: Watches K8s pod events and Kafka credential-fetch/release events, forwards into e5-deployment-mgmt-service over gRPC

e5-rf-fb-worker-core.purpose: Python function-block worker SDK; publishes credential-fetch/release Kafka events consumed by e5-platform-ss-credential-monitor

e5-workflow-manager-service.purpose: Java service driving pod actions/task release, calls e5-deployment-mgmt-service for deployment/app-name lookups

e5-platform-core.purpose: Workflow runtime SDK (Temporal-based) consumed by downstream workflow-author services; not a standalone deployable

e5-task-sdk-java.purpose: akst Task/TaskTransport model + TaskProducerService routing (Kafka publish, endpoint/producer config resolution) shared by platform-core and its downstream consumers

wf-scaffolding.purpose: Reference/scaffold app for authoring workflows on platform-core - primary place to smoke-test platform-core changes end to end
